new_results.name: QFORM-NEAR-COLOOP-CAPPED-BASIS-KL-BARRIER-v1
new_results.statement: For exact rank three with hub row sqrt(c)e and a=1-c<1/2, every physical-basis law with hub marginal <=1/2 has determinant-entropy score Z_w<=2 sqrt(ac). Hence for |det Lambda|=1 the capped-basis Fresnel certificate necessarily loses at least order a^{-1/6} as a->0. Mechanism obstruction only, not a density lower bound.

new_results.name: QFORM-SOURCE-PLANE-LINE-AGGREGATE-v1
new_results.statement: If a disjoint original-coordinate source plane contributes eH+gU, a disjoint source line contributes hV, and the hub contributes gamma e X0, then with X0,(H,U),V mutually independent source objects, U,V caps <=sqrt(2), det P!=0 and b=h^T Lambda h!=0, account03/B16 r27 gives ||p_Q||_inf<=16 |gamma|^{-1/2}[|b det Lambda| det(P)^2]^{-1/4}. H and U may be arbitrarily dependent.

new_results.name: QFORM-WALSH-SHARED-BANK-NEARCOLOOP-v1
new_results.statement: For balanced rows r0=(sqrt(c),0,0), rj=m^{-1/2}(sqrt(a),eps_j,tau_j), 0<a<1/64, c=1-a, m>=132 divisible by four, and Lambda=[[0,1,0],[1,0,0],[0,0,1]], the target spectrum is exactly {1,-1,1}; all residual coordinates mix all three spectral directions; source sign-cluster aggregation plus r27 gives ||p_Q||_inf<27.015 uniformly in m,a and all cap-one product laws.
